correctness.rationale: The perfect-matching dichotomy identifies the one missing one-sided rungless facet for all even n, and proves no such facet for odd n. value.rationale: Deleting one horizontal edge is a minimal and symmetric geometric boundary defect of a recently completely classified cubic graph family. The resulting all-n integral homotopy types exhibit a new sharp mod-six higher sphere term, mixed dimensions at infinitely many even widths, and explicit transition relative to both intact and fully-open ladders. A complete infinite natural family is classified, not an arbitrary finite numerical sample.
